# Senior Frontend Engineer, Design Systems — Lumen Studio

**Lumen Studio** builds collaborative planning software for creative teams. Our web app is used by more than forty thousand designers, editors and producers every week, and our product engineering group of about sixty people works fully remote across Europe and North America.

## About the role

We are looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer to join the Design Systems team. You will build and maintain the component library that every product team at Lumen ships with, and you will work closely with designers to turn rough ideas into accessible, well-documented components.

## What you will do

- Build reusable React components in TypeScript, with clear APIs, tests and documentation.
- Own accessibility across the component library: keyboard navigation, focus management, screen reader support and WCAG 2.2 AA conformance.
- Maintain design tokens and theming, including dark mode and high-contrast themes.
- Improve performance of large, data-heavy screens through code splitting, memoisation and careful rendering.
- Partner with product engineers to migrate legacy screens onto the design system.
- Mentor engineers and review pull requests with an eye for maintainability.

## Requirements

- 5+ years of professional frontend engineering experience.
- Deep knowledge of React and TypeScript.
- Practical experience with accessibility testing and assistive technology.
- Experience building or maintaining a design system or shared component library.
- Comfort with CSS architecture, Storybook and visual regression testing.

## Nice to have

- Experience with Next.js or server-side rendering.
- Familiarity with Figma and design-to-code workflows.
- Contributions to open source UI libraries.
